name: Runtime Router and Sanitization
area: Owns router, protocol, mirror input-output, fallback, and sanitization runtime bugs.
audit_basis: Matched queued BUG IDs against regression tests in tests/test_bug*.py.
Included previously merged no-op or patch-only lineage already applied in this workspace thread for BUG-013, BUG-124, BUG-135, and BUG-138.

items.title: Non-strict tutor backend fallback is unreachable
Raw mirror mode permits delimiter injection
Invalid protocol paths silently downgrade to the fallback protocol
Empty tutor output is silently accepted in `run_probe_phase()` and `run_eval_phase()`
Runtime paths accept semantically invalid backend metadata values as success, so strict mode is bypassed on non-exception contract violations
Backend validation and fallback tooling accept non-UTF-8-safe backend strings, so probes can PASS while artifact emission still crashes
